narration_script: Chaos erupts across Little Sicily as crime surges following the death of Bobby Gnucci.
Police morale plummets and citizens fear stepping outside as the neighborhood spirals.
Frank Castle battles his inner demons, haunted by memories and the loss of his family.
Flashbacks reveal the heavy burden of his past and the relentless weight of grief.
He struggles to find purpose, questioning if he can ever escape the darkness.
Voices from the past echo in his mind, pushing him deeper into despair.
He repeats the code of the Recon Marine, anchored to a life that is long gone.
Surrounded by ghosts, Frank confronts the crushing reality of his lonely existence.
He sits in the silence, tormented by the painful echoes of a fractured family.
hook: Chaos reigns in Little Sicily as Frank Castle drowns in grief.

narration_script: An elderly woman tracks down Frank Castle and reveals a terrifying plot for revenge.
She unveils a bounty on his head, turning every criminal in the neighborhood against him.
Armed thugs flood the streets, hunting for Frank as the clock ticks down.
Gunfire shatters the quiet as waves of desperate killers close in on his location.
Frank fights his way through relentless attackers, pushing through the cramped corridors.
Innocent lives get caught in the crossfire as chaos consumes the local shop.
Frank steps in to protect the helpless, turning the tide against the armed thugs.
With brutal efficiency, he cuts down the attackers threatening the store and its owners.
Standing amidst the wreckage, Frank leaves the carnage behind as the dust finally settles.
hook: A mother seeks bloody vengeance by putting a massive bounty on Frank.

narration_script: Frank finds a glimmer of hope, reflecting on a chance encounter that mirrors his past.
He whispers a haunting rhyme, holding close the memory of his beloved family.
Flashbacks and memories blend together as he whispers into the quiet night.
He resolves to keep moving forward, carrying the weight of his mission to the end.
A fellow veteran crosses his path, offering a stark reminder of his military days.
Frank leaves his cover behind, facing the remnants of a war he cannot leave.
The shadows close in once more as old grievances resurface in the harsh light.
Begging for mercy falls on deaf ears as the final confrontation approaches.
hook: Frank embraces his grim mission as old memories drive him onward.
